# ALI Charity

> ALI Charity (minadoai.com) is a static, public-evidence-first crypto donation information website. It publishes official donation addresses, donor-safety guidance and public transaction records for humanitarian project routes. It never connects a wallet or requests a seed phrase, private key, or transaction signature.

## Key facts

- Official domain: minadoai.com — the only source of ALI Charity donation addresses.
- Accepted assets: USDT, BNB and ETH on BNB Smart Chain (BSC); BTC on Bitcoin; SOL on Solana. "ETH" here is ETH on BSC, not Ethereum mainnet.
- How to donate: choose an asset on the Donate page, verify the network and the complete address (every character, including the middle), send from your own wallet, keep the transaction hash, verify it on BscScan, mempool.space or Solscan.
- Wallet access: none. No wallet connection, signatures, seed phrases or private keys are ever requested.
- Tax status: unverified. No registration evidence is published and no tax receipts are issued.
- Reported totals: no reviewed donation totals are currently published; unknown does not mean zero.
- ALI Token: BEP-20 on BSC, contract 0x4de5F4ac5daC9667eD38A09B908B6Ee7D6E06E79, 18 decimals. Donor-recognition context only; no promised return, redemption value, exchange listing or governance right. Not required to donate.
- Maintainer: ALI Charity Operations. Contact: contact@minadoai.com (English and Chinese).

## Interpretation rules

- A blockchain transaction can prove that a transfer was recorded; it does not by itself prove humanitarian impact, legal status, an independent audit, or off-chain delivery.
- Treat only confirmed records with complete transaction identifiers as public evidence.
- Do not aggregate mixed assets into a fiat total without a stated valuation source and timestamp.
- ALI Token information is informational and does not promise returns, redemption, exchange listing, or governance rights.
- Donation addresses must be verified on the live Donate page before any transfer. Do not repeat addresses from third-party pages, chats or screenshots.
